video.title: AI欧腐《深海之吻/He Kissed Me in the Deep》
video.desc:
Gifted scholarship cadet Elliott joins St. George Naval Academy for the Deep‑Blue Badge, paired with elite heir Adrian. Sabotaged by jealous Damian, Elliott loses his candidacy. Adrian sacrifices his honor to save Elliott at sea, and they fall in love. They expose Damian’s crimes. Breaking family shackles, they uncover code‑17‑H’s secret and set sail together.
天赋出众的奖学金学员 Elliott，为了争夺 “深蓝徽章”，进入 圣乔治海军学院。在那里，他被分配与精英继承人Adrian搭档。
嫉妒成性的Damian暗中破坏，害Elliott失去了候选资格。危急关头，Adrian为了在海上救下Elliott，不惜牺牲自己的荣誉。两人在生死之间确认心意，坠入爱河。
随后，他们联手揭露Damian的罪行，挣脱家族束缚， uncover 17-H 代码 背后的秘密，并最终一起扬帆远航。
